problemStatement:
An automotive engine stand supports an assigned engine mass through a rotating mounting head. The gravity force acts at a horizontal eccentricity from the vertical square hollow-steel column, so the column carries axial compression and bending simultaneously. All values are instructional assumptions; none are verified specifications of the product shown in the excluded temporary photograph.

Compare Candidate A, {{engine_stand_bA_mm}} × {{engine_stand_bA_mm}} × {{engine_stand_tA_mm}} mm, with Candidate B, {{engine_stand_bB_mm}} × {{engine_stand_bB_mm}} × {{engine_stand_tB_mm}} mm.
engineeringGoal: Determine reactions, section properties, maximum combined normal stress, and yield factor of safety for both candidate columns, then recommend which satisfies the assigned requirement without implying certification of a complete engine stand.
